fixed_protocol.selection: validation queries only; test and full corpus not used for model selection
fixed_protocol.features: professional text and extracted skills; no identifiers or reference labels

limitations: All vacancies and most/all resumes appear in training pairs: this is a warm, shared-document experiment.
Full-corpus metrics mix training, validation and test pairs and are not independent PMI acceptance.
Held-out-pair ranking has 58 candidates/query rather than 194 and is not directly comparable to the presentation.
The legacy production NER has historical training overlap with the corpus.
The regressor predicts proxy relevance from text features; it does not prove possession of inferred skills.
This learned Score is experimental and differs from the approved two-component scoring formula; no production deployment performed.

presentation_reference.scope: annotated: reference skills passed to scorer, not automatic extraction
